title: token-level-observability-dashboard-and-alert-tuning
author: Ava Chen
description: Add token-level cost and latency observability end-to-end: emit new token-level metrics from the serving runtime, add Grafana dashboard panels for token-cost breakdown and per-route latency distributions, and tune alert thresholds and runbooks to reduce noise. This PR implements a compact metric shape (redwood_token_cost_total, redwood_token_latency_seconds_bucket with route/model labels), wires traces to include token-boundary spans for better SLI attribution, updates logging to include token batching tags, and provides a dashboard JSON + alerting rules for staging and production. Motivation: customers and internal teams need transparent per-token unit economics and latency hot-spot visibility to optimize batching/quantization decisions and catch regressions early. Changes were validated in staging with synthetic traffic mirroring production token distributions. See linked Linear tasks and runbook links in the checklist. Checklist: [x] runtime metric emission and unit tests, [x] trace/span tagging and test traces, [x] grafana dashboard panels, [x] alert rule adjustments and runbook, [x] docs and examples updated, [x] rollback plan and migration notes. Related Linear: ENG-5234, ENG-5331.
commits: feat(observability): emit redwood_token_cost_total with model/route labels
feat(tracing): add token-boundary spans and batch_id tag
chore(dashboard): add grafana token_cost_latency dashboard JSON
fix(alerts): tune token latency thresholds and add suppression window
docs: add token-level observability guide and examples
review_comments: Ravi Patel: Please add cardinality guidance for route/model labels to avoid high-cardinality metric explosion. Suggest sampling for rare routes.
Ava Chen: Added note in docs and changed metric to include 'route_type' coarse label; also added sampling flag for rare routes.
Marta Gómez: Alert thresholds in prod look noisy under burst traffic; recommend suppression window of 2m and a count-based alert to avoid single-spike firing.
Ava Chen: Implemented suppression window and count-based alert; added runbook link to the alert definition.
Jordan Lee: Approved after minor nits on dashboard panel titles and unit test comments.
CI bot: One flaky unit-test detected in metrics formatting; test updated to be deterministic.
Release manager: Squash-merge acceptable; ensure migration note is included in release notes.
release_notes: Added token-level cost and latency observability: new metrics (redwood_token_cost_total, redwood_token_latency_seconds_bucket), Grafana dashboard for token-cost and latency breakdowns, and tuned alerts with runbooks. Low-risk; observability-only changes.
summary: Implements end-to-end token-level metrics, dashboards, and alert tuning to surface per-token cost and latency signals for optimization and regression detection. Validated in staging and merged to main.
